description: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Fetch and read the web] Splits text you send, or the main content of one public page, into heading-aware chunks of at most max_tokens with optional overlap, each with its heading path and an approximate token count, for RAG ingestion. Input: text (POST for long text) or url; max_tokens 50-4000, overlap_tokens. Limits: 400,000 characters, 2,000 chunks; robots.txt obeyed for url.

overlap_tokens.description: Tokens repeated from the previous chunk, 0 to half of max_tokens (default 50)

text.description: Plain text or Markdown, 1-400,000 characters (short text in the query; long text as POST JSON {"text": "..."}) (or give url)

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com (instead of text)

name: text_chunk
title: Text chunker for RAG (heading-aware, token-sized chunks)
